fact: The Government of South Sudan's National ICT Policy sets a government policy statement for the telecommunications, postal and information technology sectors; the page prints no year, so the published date of 2012 is used and the policy is read as adopted because the government has published it and nothing calls it a draft.

The policy text (policy statement, postal, telecommunications and information technology sector policy) is held on the ICT Policy Africa document page as a government publication, of which page 1 of 3 was captured; the date is the published date of 2012, the page printing none.

The minister of ICT and postal services told the 30th EACO Assemblies in Juba that the government is implementing the revised ICT Policy of 2012; the article gives no date for the remarks, so its published date is used.

The minister claimed the government is implementing the revised ICT Policy of 2012 and gave no figure or measure against its own targets; the article gives no date for the remarks, so its published date is used.
